findings.description: After the apple moves to the left hand (~00:05), both hands cup the apple at 00:06-00:07 and no fingers wrap the umbrella shaft; the shaft terminates at the back of the hands and by 00:07 ends in mid-air above the hands with a visible gap. Despite zero supporting contact, the canopy stays rigidly overhead and translates in sync with the subject's gait, i.e. the umbrella moves as if held without contact being established. A grip is only re-established ~00:08 when the hands clasp the shaft.
